# serverguard24_integrations (Data Source)

Retrieves all available Serverguard24 integrations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "serverguard24_integrations" "all" {}

output "integrations" {
  value = data.serverguard24_integrations.all.integrations
}

output "by_name" {
  value = data.serverguard24_integrations.all.by_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `by_id` (Attributes Map) Map of integration ID to integration object for lookup by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--by_id))
- `by_name` (Attributes Map) Map of integration name to integration object for lookup by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--by_name))
- `integrations` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integrations))
